sentences.span: The issue is whether the cost of capital and physical bottlenecks prevent that demand from translating into actual spending... you risk an air pocket in orders
sentences.why: Goldman's Privorotsky frames the real risk as cost-of-capital/financing, not demand, directly supporting the causal claim; corroborated by the Volta 11% chip-loan piece (20221) showing lenders charging far more to finance AI builds, and by multiple notes (20321/20331/20406) confirming ASML's beat-and-raise did not stop the stock or sector from falling.

sentences.span: underperformers include ASML (-3.9% despite a beat-and-raise)
sentences.why: ASML's 2026 sales guide raise and 'cannot meet customer demand' are confirmed verbatim in 20331 ('upgraded its 2026 revenues to €44-45bn'; 'we cannot meet the demand we have from customers'); the -3.9% fall is confirmed in 20406; the credit-vs-orders framing matches 20224's conclusion that the debt market, not demand, is the constraint.

sentences.span: SOXX ETF down 7 days in a row...The next bounce, however, is likely one to really lean into on the sell side before a more drawn out decline
sentences.why: BTIG's Krinsky note confirms seven straight SOXX losses and the sell-the-bounce call; Goldman's Privorotsky (20224) is quoted saying the hardware leg is 'a dip that ultimately gets bought.'

sentences.span: core goods prices to rise 0.25% m/m, while higher rents and hotels pushed up shelter prices to 0.37%. ... Headline CPI rose 0.6% m/m on the back of energy prices, with gasoline rising 9.1%
sentences.why: Source distinguishes shelter/goods driving the core upside surprise from gasoline driving the separate headline move; SEB (20277) independently calls it 'the second consecutive month' of upside surprise, supporting the 'second straight' framing.

sentences.span: Core CPI (MoM) +0.33% for September vs. GS +0.24%, median forecast +0.2%
sentences.why: 0.33% rounds to 0.3% against a 0.2% median forecast; year-over-year move to 2.6% from 2.4% confirmed in 20277 ('2.6% y/y... previous 2.4%').

sentences.span: OER increasing by 0.35% month-over-month...concentrated in the Midwest (+0.68%, SA by GS)
sentences.why: Goldman's OER (owners' equivalent rent, i.e. housing cost for homeowners) and Midwest figures match exactly; PNC's note (20268) states diesel costs are 'taking the baton from tariffs as the primary driver of goods inflation,' matching the second clause.

sentences.span: Over the past three months, core CPI inflation has increased at a 3.4% annualized pace
sentences.why: Exact figure match, attributed correctly to PNC.

sentences.span: we estimate that the core PCE price index rose 0.32% in September (vs. our expectation of 0.20% before the CPI release)
sentences.why: Goldman explicitly revised its core PCE estimate upward following the CPI data; core PCE being the Fed's preferred gauge is standard accurate terminology, not sourced to a bank but not in dispute.

sentences.span: mkt now pricing hike probability odds: 35% Oct and 87% December. GIR continues to expect that the Fed will deliver a second hike in December
sentences.why: October priced near a coin flip intraday (per 20406, ~50% right after the print) while December is treated as near-consensus across desks (GIR 87%, SEB ~90%, ING's base case, 20388's third-hike framing), supporting the 'nobody argues with December' characterization.

sentences.span: Oct rate hike probability moved from ~20% to ~50% immediately after CPI, then reversed down to 33%
sentences.why: Confirms near-50% odds right after the data; PNC's headline 'October hike back in play' and Natixis's 'Live October Meeting' are the two desks keeping the October hike alive.

sentences.span: Several Fed members have indicated that they want to evaluate the effects of the September rate hike
sentences.why: Near-verbatim match to the sentence, correctly attributed to SEB.

sentences.span: mkt now pricing hike probability odds: 35% Oct and 87% December
sentences.why: Exact figures and bank attribution match.

sentences.span: Raised our December 2026 Brent price forecast to $90/bbl (from $85/bbl) given ongoing downside risks to oil supply
sentences.why: Forecast raise, from/to figures and reason match exactly; Brent spot at $106 confirmed in 20336 ('Brent $106') and 20365 ('Brent Oil @ 106.26'); $106-$90=$16 arithmetic checks out.

sentences.span: Brent oil in 3m: scenario-weighted implied vs ... Implied: 97.0 Current: latest market price 100.6
sentences.why: Both figures appear exactly in SEB's table, correctly paired as the scenario-weighted 3-month view versus the other value in the same note.

sentences.span: 123 S&P names are up 25% or more -- while only 42 are down 25% or more...Net exposure on Goldman's global prime book is in the 10th percentile
sentences.why: Both figures and the attribution to Pasquariello match exactly; 'investor positioning' is a fair paraphrase of 'net exposure on Goldman's global prime book.'
